第001章重生高三
华夏国，汉阳省，武州市。
武州第一高中，高三上学期期中考试。
高三6班教室格外安静，只有铅笔划过试卷的沙沙声。
教室之中，一个身穿蓝白校服，剑眉星目，半边刘海遮住清秀脸庞的少年，正趴在桌子上昏昏欲睡。
突然，他毫无征兆猛地站起，脸色狰狞，发出一声悲痛欲绝的怒吼：“小师妹！”
少年的一声爆发，瞬间吸引了全班同学的目光。所有人都呆呆的看着陈默，就连两名监考老师也不例外。
噗嗤！
不知道是谁第一个笑了起来，跟着，全班同学哄堂大笑。
“小师妹？哈哈，陈默这家伙是不是睡糊涂了？”
“我看他是武侠小说看多了，小师妹？我还令狐冲呢！”
瞬间，安静严肃的考场，乱成一锅粥，那些平时学习不好的同学，赶忙趁机偷看提前抄写在手掌中的答案，小纸条乱飞。
坐在靠窗位置，梳着一个长长马尾辫，气质出众的校花安可悦，看着陈默暗暗摇头。
“虽然爸妈一直想要撮合我与他，可这种不学无术的纨绔子弟，即便是有个好家世，将来注定也一事无成。跟元昊哥比起来，他简直一无是处。”
想到这，安大校花偷偷看了眼不远处那名器宇轩昂的俊朗少年，武州市副领导的独子，郑元昊。
而郑元昊也正回头看向她，顿时，安可悦没来由的一阵紧张，赶忙低下头。
郑元昊收回目光，转而又扫了眼呆呆站着的陈默，脸上闪过一抹极度的轻蔑，这种人，根本不配做他郑元昊的情敌。
两名监考老师愤怒的看了表情呆滞的陈默一眼，无奈摇头，一脸这家伙没救了的表情。
然后，赶忙连声喝斥，稳定考场秩序，并收缴了一大堆小纸条。
陈默呆呆站在教室中，一脸茫然。

“怎么回事？我是玄道宗化神境大修士陈默，一次和小师妹私入众仙禁地‘宇宙之眼’，想要探寻众仙起源，小师妹为了救我粉身碎骨，怎么会突然出现在这里？”
想起小师妹洛璃在最后一刻，那独有的蓝色双眸中透出的依恋，还有绝美脸庞上挂着的淡淡微笑，深深印入陈默灵魂深处，铭刻在骨子里，让他悲痛万分！
但是，眼前真实的一切，却让陈默迅速收敛心神，眼中渐渐恢复清明。
迅速打量所处环境，周围一切让他有种久违的熟悉感。
“这里好像是教室？似乎在，考试？”
嗯？
有人在背后踢了陈默一脚，陈默转头看去，发现一个胖子正对着他挤眉弄眼，示意他坐下。
“你是，赵刚？”一个名字浮现在陈默脑海，他情不自禁的呐呐自语。
顷刻间，纷杂的记忆如同电影回放，让陈默终于明白如今所处之地。
“莫非这里是地球，我正在参加高三上半学期的期中考试？”陈默盯着胖子赵刚疑惑问道。
“这里不是地球，难道是火星？陈默同学，我看你是睡糊涂了吧！”戴着黑框大眼镜的女监考老师，黑着脸瞪着陈默冷喝。
“你自己成绩不好，不求上进，在期中考试上睡觉。但是请你不要影响其他同学考试，不然我只好请你离开考场！”
女监考老师掐着腰，气呼呼的瞪着陈默，大有你再说一句我就把你赶出去的架势。
陈默转头看向女老师，脸色平淡，一个名字呼之欲出！王丽，他高三时期的英语老师。
一个惊骇的念头浮现在陈默脑海。
“难道我没死？我重生了，重生回地球高三时期的少年时代？”
content_en:
Chapter 001 Rebirth of Senior High School
Huaxia Kingdom, Hanyang Province, Wuzhou City.
Wuzhou No. 1 High School, midterm exam in the first semester of senior high school.
The classroom of Class 6, Grade 3, was extremely quiet, with only the rustle of pencils scratching across test papers.
In the classroom, a young man wearing a blue and white school uniform, with sharp eyebrows and starry eyes, half of his bangs covering his handsome face, was lying on the table and falling asleep.
Suddenly, without warning, he stood up abruptly, with a ferocious expression on his face, and let out a grief-stricken roar: "Little Junior Sister!"
The boy's outburst instantly attracted the attention of the whole class. Everyone stared at Chen Mo blankly, even the two invigilators.
Poof!
I don’t know who laughed first, and then the whole class burst into laughter.
"Junior sister? Haha, is this guy Chen Mo sleepy?"
"I think he has read too many martial arts novels, little junior sister? I still read Linghu Chong!"
In an instant, the quiet and solemn examination room turned into chaos. Those students who usually did not study well hurriedly took the opportunity to peek at the answers copied in their palms in advance, and small notes flew everywhere.
Sitting by the window, An Keyue, the school beauty with a long ponytail and outstanding temperament, looked at Chen Mo and shook his head secretly.
"Although my parents have always wanted to bring me and him together, such an ignorant and ignorant playboy is destined to achieve nothing in the future, even if he has a good family background. Compared with Brother Yuanhao, he is nothing."
Thinking of this, the campus beauty of An University secretly glanced at the handsome young man not far away, Zheng Yuanhao, the only son of the deputy leader of Wuzhou City.
Zheng Yuanhao was also looking back at her. Suddenly, An Keyue felt nervous for no reason and quickly lowered her head.
Zheng Yuanhao withdrew his gaze and glanced at Chen Mo, who was standing blankly. A flash of extreme contempt flashed across his face. This kind of person was not worthy of being Zheng Yuanhao's love rival.
The two invigilators looked angrily at Chen Mo, who had a dull expression, and shook their heads helplessly, with expressions on their faces that this guy was hopeless.
Then, he hurriedly scolded him, stabilized the order in the examination room, and confiscated a lot of small notes.
Chen Mo stood blankly in the classroom with a confused look on his face.
"What's going on? I am Chen Mo, a great cultivator of the Xuan Dao Sect's Divine Realm. Once, I secretly entered the 'Eye of the Universe', a forbidden place for immortals, with my junior sister. I wanted to explore the origin of the immortals. Why did my junior sister suddenly appear here after being shattered to pieces in order to save me?"
Thinking of the last moment of junior sister Luo Li, the attachment revealed in her unique blue eyes and the faint smile hanging on her beautiful face were deeply imprinted in Chen Mo's soul and engraved in his bones, making him extremely sad!
However, what was really happening in front of him made Chen Mo quickly calm down, and his eyes gradually regained clarity.
Quickly surveying his surroundings, everything around him gave him a long-lost sense of familiarity.
"This seems to be a classroom? It seems like it's an exam?"
Huh?
Someone kicked Chen Mo in the back. Chen Mo turned around and saw a fat man winking at him, gesturing for him to sit down.
"Are you, Zhao Gang?" A name appeared in Chen Mo's mind, and he couldn't help but mutter to himself.
In an instant, the complex memories were like movie playbacks, allowing Chen Mo to finally understand where he was now.
"Could it be that this is the earth and I'm taking the midterm exam in the first half of my senior year of high school?" Chen Mo asked, staring at the fat Zhao Gang in confusion.
"This isn't the Earth, could it be Mars? Chen Mo, I think you are sleepy!" The female invigilator wearing large black-rimmed glasses glared at Chen Mo and shouted coldly.
"You have poor grades, don't seek to improve, and sleep on the midterm exam. But please don't affect other students' exams, otherwise I will have to ask you to leave the exam room!"
The female invigilator pinched her waist and stared at Chen Mo angrily, as if if you say another word, I will kick you out.
Chen Mo turned to look at the female teacher, his face was dull, and a name was about to come out! Wang Li, his English teacher during his senior year of high school.
A horrifying thought occurred to meNow Chen Mo's mind.
"Am I not dead? Am I reborn, back to my teenage years in high school on Earth?"
